transliteration: samāsenoditas tv eṣa samayācāraniścayaḥ / krayavikrayasaṃjāto vivādaḥ śrūyatām ayam //
sph_interpretive_translation: Thus succinctly declared is the determination of custom and conduct; let this dispute arising from sale and purchase be heard.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the clarity of established custom (samaya) aligned with dharma-vyavahara
Causation arises from transactional intent, not mere exchange
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness and consent at the time of agreement
Restoration logic demands resolution that reaffirms the integrity of mutual understanding
Consciousness alignment requires both parties to return to the original state of shared intention
executable_legal_axioms: IF a commercial dispute arises FROM a sale or purchase THEN invoke samaya (customary practice) AS the first frame of reference
IF intent deviation EXISTS THEN realign parties TO pre-agreement consciousness THROUGH restorative dialogue
IF capacity WAS present AT time of contract THEN uphold contractual consequence WITHIN dharma boundary
IF misalignment OCCURS post-agreement THEN initiate completion process UNTIL mutual recognition IS restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, disputes rooted in commercial transactions shall prioritize samaya (custom) as interpretive law. The threshold of responsibility lies in conscious assent. Authority flows from alignment with sanatana vyavahara, not statutory overlay. Restoration occurs through re-establishment of shared dharmic intent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality locates truth in witnessed intent and reciprocal acknowledgment. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces the sequential unfolding from agreement to discord. Proportional responsibility aligns with the degree of conscious deviation. The non-punitive reality rule affirms correction through completion, not penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vivāda Śūnyatā Sandarbha – a structured dialogue restoring neutrality between transacting parties
Execute Samaya Pratipatti Sankalpa – a mutual reaffirmation of original agreement within dharma context
Deploy Chitta Sthiti Pratishtha – a guided meditation protocol for both parties to reclaim pre-conflict consciousness
Undertake Vyavahara Shuddhi Kriya – purification of transactional memory through ritualized acknowledgment and release
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This resolution restores the transactional field to its original dharmic alignment. Justice is executed not as punishment but as consciousness reintegration. Reality is non-punitive. Dharma prevails.
